name: Dreadrider's Stomp still hits a feared target (#9846)
contract: Dreadrider's Stomp 804702 and Hellfire Trample 804704 are pure self-centered AoE effects (EffectImplicitTargetA/B 22/15 and 47/0, EffectRadiusIndex 14) with no explicit unit target at all; their tooltips promise damage to 'nearby enemies' with no crowd-control exception. Both carry Spell.dbc AttributesEx6 256 (SPELL_ATTR6_DO_NOT_CHAIN_TO_CROWD_CONTROLLED_TARGETS), confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer against the server's Spell.dbc. SpellInfo::CheckTarget (SpellInfo.cpp:2102) applies that bit to every implicitly-selected target, so a feared enemy (UNIT_STATE_FLEEING, part of UNIT_STATE_CONTROLLED) was silently dropped from the AoE's target list -- the attribute's documented purpose is to stop a chain-type spell from breaking CC on uninvolved targets, not to exclude CC'd targets from a flat stomp around the caster. AscensionCompatChangelogScript::OnLoadSpellCustomAttr now clears the bit for 804702/804704 at load time, the same pattern already used for 83086/9930889. Fear 5782 (EffectApplyAuraName[0] SPELL_AURA_MOD_FEAR) puts the target in UNIT_STATE_FLEEING without any CoA-specific mechanic, isolating the native attribute check. The feared fixture is entry 38 (Defias Thug, CreatureImmunitiesId 0), not the usual entry 36 dummy: entry 36 (Harvest Golem) carries creature_immunities row -93 (MechanicsMask 16777248, FEAR|HORROR), so it cannot be feared at all and would make this scenario untestable.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Dreadrider's Stomp requires a main-hand weapon (EquippedItemClass 2)
Fear before mounting: Fear has no SPELL_ATTR0_ALLOW_WHILE_MOUNTED
SETUP: the target is fleeing in fear
SETUP: no Stomp damage on either dummy before the cast
Xorothian Warsteed mount, required by CasterAuraState (AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp:275); no wait here so the feared target has not yet fled out of Stomp's 8 yd radius
CONTROL: Stomp hits the non-feared dummy
DISCRIMINATING: Stomp still hits the feared dummy
